title: A boolean filter argument may reference the same column several times
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], Customer[Country] = "JP" || Customer[Country] = "FR" ) )

source.quote: The syntax above is internally transformed in the following one
source.supports: the article's Red or Blue predicate on one column is turned into one FILTER over ALL of that column

derivation: JP is Cho (3): rows 5, 6 = 200 + 30 = 230. FR is Dee (4): no sales. Total 230.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
